items.title: Conrad "Connie" Jones Interview, 1981-09-01
items.q: I guess the best all around multi-instrumentalist I ever met in my life was from Detroit, went to Wayne State University, Billy Prince.

ctx.x: The Gabriel Brothers and their father are up there. Different ones, different New Orleans musicians are up around there too.
I guess the best all around multi-instrumentalist I ever met in my life was from Detroit, went to Wayne State University, Billy Prince. What's his name?
